title: DORA Dataset
content:
Parameter for Databricks integration

Integration to Databricks has been parameterized. For Databricks connection the SQLEnpoint is used so if this changes it can be updated from Dataset settings, see the figure below.

The parameter is used in all tables in Dataset that is based on Databricks data, see example from PowerBI desktop for dora_change_lead_time table. The table definition as shown below is available by using Model view and then Transform data on the top menu and lastly choosing Advanced editor.

Update Data source credentials

From time to time, Data source credentials need to be refreshed with a new token.

To refresh it, go to the Dataset Settings:

And in Data Source credentials, you need to log in with your SSO Inter-Ikea account to refresh the token.

If the project has been paused, it can be rescheduled again:

Data Source Credentials are attached to one specific user, and it’s always possible to switch to other users just by Taking over.

When updating credentials, be sure that window Popups are allowed in the browser.

Update dataset

This is a small guide that explains how to update a dataset in PowerBI.

  1. Download the dataset from PowerBI web application. The desktop application includes additional features to work with datasets.

  2. Open Power Query Editor from the desktop application and the dataset pbix file.

  3. On the left side is visible the list of included tables, adding new tables is possible using New Source or Recent Sources buttons. Then it’s possible to search for specific Databricks tables.

  4. It’s important to update the SQL endpoint as mentioned in https://i-p-e-x.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/DEVOPS/pages/36260220057/DORA+Dataset#Parameter-for-Databricks-integration. Once done it can be saved and closed.

  5. When the table is added, it may be visible in the Model View. But then it needs to be connected to other tables, but that depends on the data and how will be used.

  6. The Dataset can be published straight away from the Desktop application using the Publish button.
